title: Linux basics: users, groups and permissions
description: You are the new system administrator of a small company server. Set up accounts and a shared folder for the sales team.
objectives: Create users and groups from the command line
Understand owner/group/other permissions and octal notation

tasks.title: Create the 'sales' group
hints: Groups are managed with commands that start with 'group'.
Look at 'man groupadd'. You will need administrator rights.

tasks.title: Create users anna and bram
tasks.instructions: Create the users 'anna' and 'bram', each with a home directory and with 'sales' as a supplementary group.
hints: useradd has options for creating a home directory and for setting groups.

checks.description: anna exists and is in sales
bram exists and is in sales

tasks.title: Shared folder /srv/sales
tasks.instructions: Create /srv/sales owned by root and group 'sales'. Members of sales may read and write; everyone else gets no access at all.
hints: You need three commands: one to create, one to change ownership, one to change permissions.
In octal notation, rwx = 7, rw- = 6, --- = 0. Directories also need x to be entered.
